0022600229.text: The Mavericks (7-4, third in the Southwest... ) — wait, correcting: Dallas (7-4) is 4th in the Southwest and 9th in the West, has won three straight, and is 7-3 over its last ten, while Minnesota (8-3) is 1st in the Northwest and 4th in the West, has won four straight, and is also 7-3 over its last ten. Dallas is away for its 12th game of the season, and the Mavericks are without Dereck Lively II (out, foot surgery), Sergio de Larrea (out, knee strain), and Tarik Biberovic (out, heel inflammation), while Morez Johnson Jr. is day-to-day with a lower leg bruise and is a game-time decision; Minnesota is without Anthony Edwards (out, knee surgery) and Donte DiVincenzo (out, Achilles surgery). The teams have not met yet in the 2026-27 season, but Dallas lost 0-4 to Minnesota in the 2025-26 season, including a 124-94 loss in Dallas on March 30, 2026.
